description: 40 claims over Attention Is All You Need, BERT, and LoRA. Expected labels are for scoring only and are never passed to retrieval or verification.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017)
BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers (Devlin et al., 2019)
LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models (Hu et al., 2021)

claims.claim: The Transformer dispenses with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
The Transformer architecture is based solely on attention mechanisms.
BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text.
BERT uses masked language modeling and next sentence prediction during pre-training.
BERT's model architecture is a multi-layer bidirectional Transformer encoder.
LoRA freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices.
LoRA represents weight updates with a low-rank decomposition instead of updating the full weight matrix.
LoRA introduces no additional inference latency compared with full fine-tuning.
LoRA was evaluated on RoBERTa, DeBERTa, GPT-2, and GPT-3.
BERT obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks.
The Transformer architecture uses recurrent layers.
